paragraphs.en: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种方法，可在完全基于纹理空间的情况下生成高质量三维物体材料。 我们对视频扩散变换器进行了微调，以实现文本引导的材料生成、多视角材料生成以及材料超分辨率处理。 我们的关键思路是利用从图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，使扩散过程能够泛化到任意几何形状和纹理参数化。 这种方法还能避免视频和多视角扩散模型中固有的视角一致性问题。 由于纹理空间是二维的，我们可以复用预训练视频扩散模型中强大的先验知识。 我们将该方法应用于从未知光照条件下拍摄的带姿态照片中进行高质量材料重建，以及文本和图像引导的材料生成。 我们的方法可扩展至高分辨率（8K）、100多个输入视角以及神经材料表示。 在定量和定性评估中，我们在材料生成与重建方面展示了当前最先进的结果。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we focus on the task of generating realistic materials for 3D objects from text descriptions and/or photographs. A common way of representing realistic materials for a 3D object is storing the spatially varying material parameters in texture maps. This is the standard approach for materials in 3D graphics systems, e.g., Blender and Unreal Engine. However, authoring detailed materials on complex 3D assets is a labor-intensive task.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们专注于根据文本描述和/或照片生成 3D 对象的逼真材质这一任务。 表示 3D 对象逼真材质的常见方法是将空间变化的材质参数存储在纹理图中。 这是 3D 图形系统（例如 Blender 和 Unreal Engine）中处理材质的标准方法。 然而，为复杂的 3D 资产创建详细材质是一项劳动密集型任务。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in generative modeling have made it increasingly practical to synthesize 3D geometry and appearance from text or images. Existing approaches broadly fall into two categories: image-space and object-space models.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式建模领域的最新进展使得根据文本或图像合成三维几何结构和外观变得越来越实用。 现有方法大致可分为两类：图像空间模型和对象空间模型。

sents.en: Recent advances in generative modeling have made it increasingly practical to synthesize 3D geometry and appearance from text or images.
sents.zh: 生成式建模领域的最新进展使得根据文本或图像合成三维几何结构和外观变得越来越实用。

sents.en: Existing approaches broadly fall into two categories: image-space and object-space models.
sents.zh: 现有方法大致可分为两类：图像空间模型和对象空间模型。

paragraphs.en: Image-space methods ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024d ; Youwang et al., 2024 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) build on image or video generative models to produce multiple views of an object, from which geometry and materials are reconstructed using optimization through differentiable rendering. They are mainly limited by view consistency: the same surface point may be predicted differently across generated views, often leading to reduced details, suppressed specular highlights or blurred textures.
paragraphs.zh: 图像空间方法（Poole 等人，2023；Deng 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2024d；Youwang 等人，2024；Munkberg 等人，2025；Hasselgren 等人，2026）基于图像或视频生成模型来生成物体的多个视图，并通过可微渲染进行优化，从而重建其几何结构和材质。 这些方法的主要局限性在于视图一致性：同一表面点在不同生成的视图中可能会被预测为不同的结果，这常常导致细节减少、镜面高光被抑制或纹理模糊。

sents.en: Image-space methods ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024d ; Youwang et al., 2024 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) build on image or video generative models to produce multiple views of an object, from which geometry and materials are reconstructed using optimization through differentiable rendering.

paragraphs.en: Object-space methods ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) instead rely on three-dimensional representations such as sparse voxel grids or triplanes. Because features are attached to fixed locations, these methods avoid view-consistency issues. However, sparse 3D representations are memory- and compute-intensive, require specialized complex architectures, and are trained from scratch on synthetic data rather than leveraging the priors of large video foundation models, which may lead to lower visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 对象空间方法（Xiang 等，2026；He 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Yu 等，2024；Li 等，2026a；Li 等，2026b）则依赖稀疏体素网格或三角平面等三维表示。 由于特征被绑定在固定位置，这些方法可以避免视图一致性问题。 然而，稀疏三维表示在内存和计算上消耗巨大，需要专门的复杂架构，并且是从零开始在合成数据上进行训练的，而不是利用大型视频基础模型的先验知识，这可能导致视觉质量较低。

paragraphs.en: In this work, inspired by TEXGen ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , we explore the texture space domain for high quality material generation. Texture space is two-dimensional, allowing us to easily adapt existing image and video models, and is view consistent by design. In Figure 2 , we illustrate the concept of texture mapping, and the projection from views back into texture space. Our main target application is material estimation for a known, scanned, object with uncontrolled lighting. Each view is projected into a shared UV atlas, and a generative video model is conditioned on the shaded texture space views, generating output frames with the physically-based rendering (PBR) material parameters: ( basecolor , height , roughness , metalness ).
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们受 TEXGen（Yu 等人，2024）的启发，探索了用于高质量材质生成的纹理空间域。 纹理空间是二维的，这使我们能够轻松适配现有的图像和视频模型，并且其设计本身具有视图一致性。 在图 2 中，我们展示了纹理映射的概念，以及从各个视图反向投影到纹理空间的过程。 我们的主要目标应用是对已知且经过扫描的物体，在光照不受控制的情况下进行材质估计。 每个视图都被投影到一个共享的 UV 图集之中，而一个生成式视频模型则以带阴影的纹理空间视图为条件，生成包含物理渲染（PBR）材质参数（基础颜色、高度、粗糙度、金属度）的输出帧。

paragraphs.en: We show that our method can be made robust to inconsistencies in both input views and geometry, making it a versatile component in larger content-generation pipelines. The input views can include high quality photos from a controlled setup, phone captures, or even views generated by a (e.g. depth-conditioned) video model. The geometry can be an accurate scan, or a coarser extraction from recent image-conditioned models ( Li et al., 2026b ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了我们的方法能够应对输入视图和几何结构中的不一致性，从而使其成为更大型内容生成流程中一个通用的组件。 输入视图可以包括来自受控设置的高质量照片、手机拍摄的照片，甚至是由（例如深度条件化的）视频模型生成的视图。 几何结构可以是精确的扫描结果，也可以是从较新的图像条件化模型中提取的更粗略的结构（Li et al., 2026b; Xiang et al., 2026; Team et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We complement our multi-view to material model with a generative upscaler trained on UV-atlases of material parameters, which, combined with inference time augmentation, can be used to scale to both higher resolution (8K) and more input views (100+) than used in training. Finally, we show that text-conditioned and single-image conditioned material generations are feasible in texture space by finetuning a diffusion transformer model with a novel 3D-aware rotary positional embedding which encodes the (per-texel) world space position and frame ID. paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, the first diffusion framework that generates complete PBR materials entirely in texture space, combining a view-consistent 2D representation with pretrained image and video priors.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个完全在纹理空间中生成完整 PBR 材质的扩散框架，它将视图一致的二维表示与预训练的图像和视频先验相结合。

paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，完整的纹理空间生成能够在未知光照条件下，基于单视角或多视角图像实现稳健的材料重建。

paragraphs.en: Training-free noise rolling and coverage-aware expert aggregation scale inference to 8K textures and over 100 input views.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的噪声滚动与覆盖感知专家聚合，可扩展至 8K 纹理和超过 100 个输入视角。

paragraphs.en: Image diffusion models generate samples through iterative denoising ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) . Video diffusion models ( Blattmann et al., 2023b ; Blattmann et al., 2023a ; Hong et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; NVIDIA, 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) extend this concept to the temporal domain. Diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have become a common architecture due to their performance and flexible finetuning opportunities. In this work, we build upon the DiT-based Wan 2.1 model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and use its temporal representation to process multi-view observations and produce multiple modalities.

paragraphs.en: A common limitation of image models is the lack of view consistency, which may show up as blur in the extracted textures. Multi-view diffusion models e.g., MVDream ( Shi et al., 2024 ) address this by jointly generating images from several canonical viewpoints. SV3D ( Voleti et al., 2024 ) and Hi3D ( Yang et al., 2024 ) further improve on this aspect by finetuning video diffusion models for object rotations, and extract 3D models from the generated views. However, these approaches have limited resolution and do not provide Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials.
paragraphs.zh: 图像模型的一个常见局限性是缺乏视图一致性，这可能会在提取的纹理中表现为模糊。 多视角扩散模型（例如 MVDream（Shi 等人，2024））通过联合生成来自多个标准视角的图像来解决这一问题。 SV3D（Voleti 等人，2024）和 Hi3D（Yang 等人，2024）通过针对物体旋转对视频扩散模型进行微调，并从生成的视图中提取 3D 模型，进一步改进了这一方面。 然而，这些方法分辨率有限，并且不提供基于物理的渲染（PBR）材质。

paragraphs.en: Another direction is to apply the generative process in 3D space, which is view-consistent by design. 3DTopia-XL ( Chen et al., 2025b ) and Trellis ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) encode the 3D shape, textures, and materials in volumetric primitives anchored and jointly generates shape and PBR materials. paragraphs.en: Material reconstruction is commonly formulated as an inverse-rendering problem from dense set of inputs. Differentiable rasterization ( Laine et al., 2020 ) has been successfully applied to photogrammetry ( Munkberg et al., 2022 ) . Differentiable path tracing ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Jakob et al., 2022 ) accurately simulates global illumination effects, and has higher potential reconstruction quality ( Hasselgren et al., 2022 ) , but introduces Monte-Carlo noise in the training process, which makes gradient-based optimization more challenging. Volumetric scene representations such as NeRFs ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ) and Gaussian splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) provide a smoother optimization landscape with impressive novel-view synthesis quality, but disentangling shape, materials, and lighting is non-trivial.
paragraphs.zh: 材料重建通常被表述为一个基于密集输入集的逆渲染问题。 可微分光栅化（Laine 等人，2020）已成功应用于摄影测量（Munkberg 等人，2022）。 可微分路径追踪（Zhang 等人，2020；Jakob 等人，2022）能够精确模拟全局光照效果，并具有更高的潜在重建质量（Hasselgren 等人，2022），但在训练过程中会引入蒙特卡洛噪声，使得基于梯度的优化更具挑战性。 体积场景表示方法，如 NeRFs（Mildenhall 等人，2020）和高斯泼溅（Kerbl 等人，2023），提供了更平滑的优化景观和令人印象深刻的新型视角合成质量，但分离形状、材料和光照并非易事。

paragraphs.en: A closely related line of research is intrinsic decomposition of images, including per-pixel material parameter estimation from sparse set of inputs. paragraphs.zh: 一个密切相关的研究方向是图像的内禀分解，包括从稀疏输入集中进行逐像素的材料参数估计。 为了解决分解中的模糊性问题，近期方法使用图像或视频扩散模型来生成材料（Kocsis 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2024；Zeng 等人，2024b；Zhu 等人，2024b；Liang 等人，2025；Ying 等人，2025；Zeng 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2026），并可能结合基于优化的逆渲染方法（Kocsis 等人，2026；Munkberg 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Recent works leverage diffusion models for generating more expressive neural materials on 2D patches ( Raghavan et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) , on 3D geometry ( Yu et al., 2026 ) or to extract neural materials from images ( Youwang et al., 2026 ) . These methods are operating in image-space, while we propose to directly generate in texture space. While we focus on PBR materials in this paper, neural materials are an exciting future direction, and we include a proof-of-concept example.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究利用扩散模型在二维图像块上生成更具表现力的神经材料（Raghavan 等人，2025；Xue 等人，2026），在三维几何体上生成神经材料（Yu 等人，2026），或从图像中提取神经材料（Youwang 等人，2026）。 这些方法是在图像空间中操作的，而我们则提出直接在纹理空间中进行生成。 尽管本文主要关注 PBR 材料，但神经材料是一个激动人心的未来方向，我们在此也包含了一个概念验证示例。

paragraphs.en: Earlier approaches formulate the task of material generation as retrieval or interpolation of a database of known high-quality materials or material graphs, and learn to project the input (image or text) onto the known representation ( Zhang et al., 2024c ; Ceylan et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) . These methods are limited by the expressiveness of their material databases, but are well-regularized.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的方法将材料生成任务表述为从已知高质量材料或材料图的数据库中检索或插值，并学习将输入（图像或文本）投影到已知的表示形式上（Zhang et al., 2024c; Ceylan et al., 2024; Fang et al., 2024）。 这些方法受其材料数据库表现力的限制，但具有良好的正则化效果。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid approaches combine image diffusion models with material distillation using inpainting, or coarse-to-fine texture refinement ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2024a ; Youwang et al., 2024 ; Hadadan et al., 2025 ) . Recent methods fine-tune the diffusion model to condition on geometry or lighting ( Zhang et al., 2024d ; Deng et al., 2024 ) or even to directly generate the intrinsic properties from text or known geometry ( Kocsis et al., 2025 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) . CLAY’s ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) material generation model uses a finetuned multi-view image diffusion model ( Shi et al., 2024 ) conditioned on normal maps. The material model generates four canonical views of the PBR texture maps, which are then projected into texture space. Several recent methods ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Boss et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Engelhardt et al., 2025 ; Seed, 2025 ) extend this approach with additional input conditioning (normal, depth and/or world space positions). However, these methods operate in image space, potentially leading to texture seams and limited resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 混合方法将图像扩散模型与材料蒸馏相结合，利用图像修复或从粗略到精细的纹理优化技术（Richardson 等，2023；Chen 等，2023；Zeng 等，2024a；Youwang 等，2024；Hadadan 等，2025）。 近期方法对扩散模型进行微调，使其以几何结构或光照为条件（Zhang 等，2024d；Deng 等，2024），甚至直接从文本或已知几何结构中生成内在属性（Kocsis 等，2025；Munkberg 等，2025；Hasselgren 等，2026）。 CLAY（Zhang 等，2024b）的材料生成模型使用一个经过微调的多视角图像扩散模型（Shi 等，2024），并以法线图为条件。 该材料模型会生成 PBR 纹理映射的四个标准视图，然后将其投影到纹理空间中。 几种近期方法（Huang 等，2025；Feng 等，2025；Boss 等，2025；He 等，2025；Shao 等，2025；Yang 等，2025a；Engelhardt 等，2025；Seed，2025）通过添加额外的输入条件（法线、深度和/或世界空间位置）扩展了这一方法。 然而，这些方法在图像空间中运行，可能导致纹理接缝和分辨率受限的问题。

To provide geometry information, they interleave convolutions in texture space with attention layers on point clouds to outpaint diffuse textures. Inspired by this, we formulate the generation process entirely in texture space that can generate complete PBR materials.

paragraphs.en: Our texture space diffusion method, as shown in Figure 3 , predicts physically-based rendering (PBR) material textures ( Burley, 2012 ; Karis, 2013 ) from posed views. We assume a given 3D model with a valid texture parameterization (but no textures) as input, alongside a text prompt describing the material. Our approach is multi-modal, and can predict materials from: 1) one or multiple posed views, 2) a text prompt, or 3) low-resolution material maps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的纹理空间扩散方法（如图 3 所示）能够从给定姿态的视图中预测基于物理渲染（PBR）的材料纹理（Burley, 2012；Karis, 2013）。 我们假设输入是一个具有有效纹理参数化（但没有实际纹理）的给定 3D 模型，以及一个描述该材料的文本提示。 我们的方法是多模态的，能够从以下输入预测材料：1) 一个或多个给定姿态的视图，2) 文本提示，或 3) 低分辨率的材料贴图。

sents.zh: 我们的方法是多模态的，能够从以下输入预测材料：1) 一个或多个给定姿态的视图，2) 文本提示，或 3) 低分辨率的材料贴图。

paragraphs.en: Given known camera parameters and geometry, we project the views into texture space and formulate the diffusion process in texture space, leveraging pre-trained 2D diffusion priors (e.g., a video diffusion model). One can see our approach as a texture completion task, conditioned on world space positions, normals, and a text prompt. Our finetuned model outputs two images, representing the PBR material maps in texture space, one for base color and the other encoding a height map, roughness, and metallicity combined into an RGB image. We use the height map only for surface normal perturbation (bump mapping), but it could also be used for displacement mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 在已知相机参数和几何结构的前提下，我们将视图投影到纹理空间，并在纹理空间中构建扩散过程，同时利用预训练的二维扩散先验（例如视频扩散模型）。 我们的方法可以被视为一种纹理补全任务，其结果受世界空间位置、法线以及文本提示的条件约束。 我们微调后的模型会输出两幅图像，分别表示纹理空间中的 PBR 材质贴图：一幅用于基础颜色，另一幅则将高度图、粗糙度和金属度整合到一幅 RGB 图像中。 我们仅将高度图用于表面法线扰动（凹凸贴图），但它同样也可以用于位移贴图。

paragraphs.en: Our training data consists of path traced views of 3D models. However, real captures and current video diffusion models come with view-inconsistencies. To make our model more robust, we augment the training data with random corruptions of the input views. First, we create a version of the dataset where we add Gaussian noise to the views and denoise them with FLUX.1-dev ( Labs, 2024 ) img2img (using strength ∈ [ 0 , 0.3 ] \in[0,0.3] , guidance scale ∈ [ 0 , 3.0 ] \in[0,3.0] and 20 denoising steps). Secondly, we add Gaussian blur with randomized σ ∈ [ 0 , 15 ] \sigma\in[0,15] to the input views during training. These augmentations encourage our material extraction model to be robust to imperfections, while still producing high frequency details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的训练数据由 3D 模型的线描视图组成。 然而，真实拍摄的画面和当前的视频扩散模型都存在视图不一致的问题。 为了使模型更具鲁棒性，我们通过随机破坏输入视图来增强训练数据。 首先，我们创建了一个数据集版本，在该版本中，我们向视图添加高斯噪声，并使用 FLUX.1-dev ( Labs, 2024 ) 的 img2img 功能进行去噪（强度 ∈ [ 0 , 0.3 ] \in[0,0.3]，引导系数 ∈ [ 0 , 3.0 ] \in[0,3.0]，并执行 20 步去噪）。 其次，在训练过程中，我们向输入视图添加高斯模糊，其中 σ 随机取值于 [ 0 , 15 ] \sigma\in[0,15]。 这些增强操作促使我们的材料提取模型对不完美之处更具鲁棒性，同时仍能生成高频细节。

paragraphs.en: In this setting, we only have a single observation of the materials in a shaded view, which we project into texture space. The model, guided by the texture space sparse input and conditions, needs to demodulate lighting and inpaint plausible details in missing regions. Here 𝐈 \mathbf{I} consists of a single, sparse texture space view. To improve consistency of the generated material, inspired by RomanTex ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , we introduce a novel 3D-aware rotary positional embedding (RoPE), combining the frame ID and world space position. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply a 3D-aware RoPE in texture space. Encoding world space positions directly in RoPE supplies a stronger or more direct geometric bias than G-buffer conditioning alone, improving attention in spatially adjacent surface regions that are distant in texture space. In our supplemental material, we ablate the impact of this 3D-aware RoPE.
paragraphs.zh: 在此设定中，我们仅能获得对阴影视角下材料的单次观察，并将其投影到纹理空间中。 在纹理空间稀疏输入和条件的引导下，模型需要解调光照，并在缺失区域补绘合理的细节。 此处 𝐈 \mathbf{I} 由一个单一的、稀疏的纹理空间视图组成。 为提升生成材料的一致性，受 RomanTex（Feng 等人，2025）启发，我们引入了一种新颖的 3D 感知旋转位置嵌入（RoPE），将帧 ID 与世界空间位置相结合。 据我们所知，我们是首次在纹理空间中应用 3D 感知 RoPE。 在 RoPE 中直接编码世界空间位置，相比仅使用 G-buffer 条件约束，能提供更强的或更直接的几何偏置，从而改善纹理空间中距离较远但在空间上相邻的表面区域的注意力机制。 在我们的补充材料中，我们分析了这种 3D 感知 RoPE 的影响。

paragraphs.en: To increase the resolution of the generated material maps, we propose a texture-space generative refinement model. This model is primarily useful to complement the multi-view to material generation method of Section 3.1 . The upscaler model is similar to the single-view to material model, but with the single frame replaced with two low resolution PBR material maps (with full coverage). In training, the low resolution PBR material guides are generated by first downscaling then upscaling the reference materials with area weighted or nearest neighbor filtering (randomly selected) using the scaling factors: 2,4,8, and 16.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高生成材料图的分辨率，我们提出了一种纹理空间生成式细化模型。 该模型主要用于补充第 3.1 节中的多视角到材料生成方法。 该上采样模型与单视角到材料的模型类似，但将单帧图像替换为两张低分辨率的 PBR 材料图（具有完全覆盖）。 在训练过程中，低分辨率 PBR 材料引导图通过先对参考材料进行下采样，然后使用区域加权或最近邻滤波（随机选择）进行上采样生成，使用的缩放因子为：2、4、8 和 16。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset consists of 120k videos of object-centric renderings of 3D models from TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . For each object, we render a video with 17 frames at a resolution of 2048 × \times 2048, using a path tracer with three bounces, black background and Blender AgX tonemapping. For lighting, we use 697 light probes from Poly Haven ( Poly Haven, ) , one randomly selected for each object. Each frame is projected into texture space following Figure 2 . We automatically generate captions using Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) . We also rasterize intrinsic conditioning guides (world space positions and world space normals) directly in texture space and store them alongside reference base color, roughness, metallicity and height textures. The height map is not available for most assets, and we reconstruct it from the normal map using standard conversion tools.

paragraphs.en: Scaling transformer models to higher resolution or more input views is challenging due to attention cost. We show that inference-time methods can enable scaling beyond the training domain.
paragraphs.zh: 由于注意力计算成本高昂，将 Transformer 模型扩展到更高分辨率或更多输入视图具有挑战性。 我们证明了推理时的方法可以实现超越训练域的扩展。

sents.en: Scaling transformer models to higher resolution or more input views is challenging due to attention cost.
sents.zh: 由于注意力计算成本高昂，将 Transformer 模型扩展到更高分辨率或更多输入视图具有挑战性。

sents.en: We show that inference-time methods can enable scaling beyond the training domain.
sents.zh: 我们证明了推理时的方法可以实现超越训练域的扩展。

paragraphs.en: Our high-resolution inference uses progressive noise rolling, inspired by Bar-Tal et al. (2023) ; Vecchio et al. (2024) . We first run inference on the original 2K resolution. We upscale the resulting image to 8K, add a small amount of noise, and resume denoising from that point. In each diffusion step, we split all model inputs ( z τ 𝐦𝐚𝐭 , z 𝐈 , z c \textbf{z}_{\tau}^{\mathbf{mat}},\textbf{z}^{\mathbf{I}},\textbf{z}^{\textbf{c}} ) into non-overlapping 2K crops, evaluate 𝐟 θ \mathbf{f}_{\theta} on each crop, and stitch the result together. We hide seams by applying a random spatial roll in each diffusion step, thus randomly offsetting the crops. We apply noise rolling in the upscaling step for best runtime performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的高分辨率推理采用了渐进式噪声滚动方法，该方法受 Bar-Tal 等人（2023）和 Vecchio 等人（2024）的启发。 我们首先在原始 2K 分辨率上执行推理。 我们将生成的图像上采样至 8K，添加少量噪声，然后从该点重新开始去噪。 在每个扩散步骤中，我们将所有模型输入（ z τ 𝐦𝐚𝐭 , z 𝐈 , z c \textbf{z}_{\tau}^{\mathbf{mat}},\textbf{z}^{\mathbf{I}},\textbf{z}^{\textbf{c}} ）分割为互不重叠的 2K 裁剪块，对每个裁剪块计算 𝐟 θ \mathbf{f}_{\theta}，然后将结果拼接起来。 我们在每个扩散步骤中应用随机空间滚动来隐藏接缝，从而随机偏移这些裁剪块。 为了获得最佳运行时性能，我们在上采样步骤中应用噪声滚动。

paragraphs.en: To use more input observations, we evaluate them batch-wise and propose a fusing strategy. We split the input views into overlapping batches. In each denoising step, we predict the flow for all batches, given the same noisy latents, referred to as expert predictions. To aggregate the predictions, we compute per-texel coverage scores for all experts. These coverage maps can act as an uncertainty-measure, i.e. more views observe a texel, the more certain the prediction should be. For each texel, we keep the top-2 expert predictions and use their coverage-weighted average. This retains redundancy, while avoiding the oversmoothing that would result from averaging all experts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了利用更多的输入观测，我们以批次为单位进行评估，并提出一种融合策略。 我们将输入视图划分为重叠的批次。 在每个去噪步骤中，基于相同的含噪潜在变量，我们为所有批次预测流，这些预测被称为专家预测。 为了汇总这些预测，我们为所有专家计算每个像素点的覆盖分数。 这些覆盖图可以充当不确定性度量：即一个像素点被观测到的视图越多，预测就越应确定。 对于每个像素点，我们保留排名最高的两个专家预测，并使用它们的覆盖加权平均值。 这种方法既保留了冗余信息，又避免了平均所有专家所导致的过度平滑问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method against the state-of-the-art in multi-view to material reconstruction and text/image conditioned material generation. Additionally, we ablate robustness to view- and geometry inconsistencies, and our inference-time methods for increasing the number of input views and resolution. For quantitative results we use a synthetic dataset of 32 held out 3D models from the BlenderVault dataset ( Litman et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的方法与多视角到材质重建以及文本/图像条件材质生成领域的当前最先进方法进行了对比评估。 此外，我们还分析了模型对视角和几何结构不一致性的鲁棒性，并提出了在推理阶段增加输入视角数量和分辨率的方法。 在定量结果方面，我们使用了一个合成数据集，该数据集包含从 BlenderVault 数据集（Litman et al., 2025）中预留的 32 个 3D 模型。

sents.en: We evaluate our method against the state-of-the-art in multi-view to material reconstruction and text/image conditioned material generation.
sents.zh: 我们将我们的方法与多视角到材质重建以及文本/图像条件材质生成领域的当前最先进方法进行了对比评估。

sents.en: Additionally, we ablate robustness to view- and geometry inconsistencies, and our inference-time methods for increasing the number of input views and resolution.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还分析了模型对视角和几何结构不一致性的鲁棒性，并提出了在推理阶段增加输入视角数量和分辨率的方法。

sents.en: For quantitative results we use a synthetic dataset of 32 held out 3D models from the BlenderVault dataset ( Litman et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our multi-view material reconstruction model on two test sets: 1) A fully controlled synthetic test set with 32 examples 2) Eight real multi-view captures from the DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) dataset. For the synthetic set, we render each 3D model with extracted materials from eight viewpoints with the original lighting and in eight novel lighting conditions. For the DTC examples, we use the original lighting in rendering. Error metrics are computed as averages over all images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个测试集上评估了我们的多视角材质重建模型：1) 一个包含 32 个样本的完全受控的合成测试集；2) DTC（Dong 等人，2025）数据集中来自八个真实多视角采集的样本。 对于合成测试集，我们使用从八个视角提取的材质，在原始光照和八种新的光照条件下渲染每个 3D 模型。 对于 DTC 样本，我们在渲染时使用了原始光照。 误差指标通过计算所有图像的平均值得到。

paragraphs.en: To account for any tonemapping bias of the baselines, we fit a parametric camera response function (CRF), following Lin et al. (2025) , for each series based on ground truth renderings under the original lighting condition. Material estimation under unknown lighting is fundamentally ambiguous as observed intensity depends jointly on illumination intensity and material reflectance. Consequently, the different methods produce materials with different systematic bias in the material parameters, which can be largely reduced with CRF adjustment. For completeness, we include series without CRF adjustments in our supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: 为了消除基线方法中可能存在的色调映射偏差，我们遵循 Lin 等人（2025）的方法，为每个系列拟合了一个参数化相机响应函数（CRF），该函数基于原始光照条件下的真实渲染结果。 （2025）年，该方法基于原始光照条件下的真实渲染结果，为每个系列进行了拟合。 在未知光照条件下进行材质估计本质上具有模糊性，因为观测到的强度同时取决于光照强度和材质反射率。 因此，不同方法生成的材质在参数上会存在不同的系统性偏差，而通过调整 CRF 可以在很大程度上减少这种偏差。 为保持完整性，我们在补充材料中包含了未进行 CRF 调整的系列数据。

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 we report metrics for multi-view reconstruction for synthetic and real examples. As baselines, we include DiffPT ( Hasselgren et al., 2022 ) , an optimization-based approach through differentiable path tracing, and LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) , a large reconstruction model for geometry and material estimation. In the left part, we report metrics for renderings of the reconstructed materials with the original lighting . We note that our method (with reference geometry) has the highest scores on all metrics for the synthetic set. For the real (DTC) examples, the optimization-based approach, DiffPT, which overfits to this configuration, has slightly better metrics. In the right column, we evaluate the reconstructed materials across eight novel lighting configurations. The scores indicate that DiffPT fails to properly disentangle lighting and material information, as also shown in Figure 4 . LSRM has slightly lower scores, but solves the more challenging task of jointly reconstructing the geometry and materials. We include a series with our method using LSRM geometry, which improves slightly over LSRM across all metrics in the multi-illumination setting.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 1 中，我们报告了合成和真实示例的多视角重建指标。 作为基线方法，我们纳入了 DiffPT（Hasselgren 等人，2022），这是一种基于可微路径追踪的优化方法，以及 LSRM（Li 等人，2026b），一个用于几何和材质估计的大型重建模型。 在左侧部分，我们报告了使用原始光照对重建材质进行渲染的指标。 我们注意到，我们的方法（结合参考几何）在合成数据集的所有指标上获得了最高分数。 对于真实（DTC）示例，基于优化的 DiffPT 方法由于对该配置出现过拟合，其指标略好一些。 在右侧列中，我们对八种新的光照配置下的重建材质进行了评估。 这些分数表明，DiffPT 未能正确分离光照和材质信息，如图 4 所示。 LSRM 的分数略低，但它解决了更具挑战性的联合重建几何和材质的任务。 我们还加入了一组使用 LSRM 几何结构的我们的方法，在多光照设置中，该方法在所有指标上均比 LSRM 略有改进。

sents.en: In Table 1 we report metrics for multi-view reconstruction for synthetic and real examples.

sents.en: As baselines, we include DiffPT ( Hasselgren et al., 2022 ) , an optimization-based approach through differentiable path tracing, and LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) , a large reconstruction model for geometry and material estimation.
sents.zh: 作为基线方法，我们纳入了 DiffPT（Hasselgren 等人，2022），这是一种基于可微路径追踪的优化方法，以及 LSRM（Li 等人，2026b），一个用于几何和材质估计的大型重建模型。

sents.en: In the left part, we report metrics for renderings of the reconstructed materials with the original lighting .
sents.zh: 在左侧部分，我们报告了使用原始光照对重建材质进行渲染的指标。

sents.en: We note that our method (with reference geometry) has the highest scores on all metrics for the synthetic set.
sents.zh: 我们注意到，我们的方法（结合参考几何）在合成数据集的所有指标上获得了最高分数。

sents.en: For the real (DTC) examples, the optimization-based approach, DiffPT, which overfits to this configuration, has slightly better metrics.
sents.zh: 对于真实（DTC）示例，基于优化的 DiffPT 方法由于对该配置出现过拟合，其指标略好一些。

sents.en: In the right column, we evaluate the reconstructed materials across eight novel lighting configurations.
sents.zh: 在右侧列中，我们对八种新的光照配置下的重建材质进行了评估。

sents.en: The scores indicate that DiffPT fails to properly disentangle lighting and material information, as also shown in Figure 4 .
sents.zh: 这些分数表明，DiffPT 未能正确分离光照和材质信息，如图 4 所示。

sents.en: LSRM has slightly lower scores, but solves the more challenging task of jointly reconstructing the geometry and materials.
sents.zh: LSRM 的分数略低，但它解决了更具挑战性的联合重建几何和材质的任务。

sents.en: We include a series with our method using LSRM geometry, which improves slightly over LSRM across all metrics in the multi-illumination setting.
sents.zh: 我们还加入了一组使用 LSRM 几何结构的我们的方法，在多光照设置中，该方法在所有指标上均比 LSRM 略有改进。

paragraphs.en: To ablate robustness to imperfect views, we leverage a pre-trained video model (Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B) ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) to generate a 360 degree orbit of the 3D object, conditioned on a single image and a depth video. Here, we use a smaller test set of 17 objects, as the depth-conditioned video model struggles to generate plausible orbits for rotationally symmetrical objects. In Figure 5 , we observe that our method robustly handles view imperfections, and can produce plausible materials from views synthesized by a video model.
paragraphs.zh: 为了消除对不完美视角的脆弱性，我们利用一个预训练的视频模型（Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B）（Jiang 等人，2025），基于单张图像和深度视频生成三维物体的 360 度轨道。 在此，我们使用一个包含 17 个物体的较小测试集，因为基于深度的视频模型难以为旋转对称物体生成合理的轨道。 在图 5 中，我们观察到我们的方法能够稳健地处理视角的不完美性，并且可以从视频模型合成的视角中生成合理的材质。

paragraphs.en: Wan-2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) operates on patches of 16 × 16 16\times 16 , which is the smallest granularity for attention and RoPE. Consequently, in patches with multiple overlapping texture atlas segments our model lacks the information to distinguish them. Although higher texture resolutions mitigate this issue, patch-aware texture unwrapping, or pixel-space diffusion models are promising directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: Wan-2.1（Wan 等人，2025）在 16×16 的图像块上运行，这是注意力机制和 RoPE 的最小粒度。 因此，在包含多个重叠纹理图集分段的图像块中，我们的模型缺乏区分它们所需的信息。 虽然更高的纹理分辨率可以缓解这一问题，但基于图像块的纹理展开或像素空间扩散模型是未来研究的有前景方向。

paragraphs.en: We show that texture space diffusion models can be powerful tools for material reconstruction and generation, achieving on par or higher quality compared to the state of the art. Operating in texture space ignores the common problems of view consistency or data sparsity, making our method both simple and scalable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，纹理空间扩散模型可以成为材料重建和生成的强大工具，其质量与当前最先进的方法相当甚至更高。 在纹理空间中操作可以避免视角一致性和数据稀疏性等常见问题，因此我们的方法既简单又具备可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: Appearance decomposition is a highly ambiguous task, making quantitative evaluations challenging. To account for the ambiguity, we fit a parametric camera response function (CRF) and exposure value for all the multi-view methods presented in the paper. We parametrize the response function using Grossberg and Nayar (2004) and fit it with a rerendering loss ( Liu et al., 2020 ) . Specifically, for all the available views, we render the object in HDR using the original lighting condition and the predicted materials. Then, we start an alternating optimization between exposure and CRF fitting, giving a total of 10 trainable parameters (1 exposure and 3 curve parameters for each color channel). We apply the exposure, then the learned CRF to tonemap the image and compare against the original image using L1 loss. We tune the exposure for 25 steps, then the CRF parameters for 200 steps and alternate for 20 cycles using learning rate of 0.01. Following IRIS ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we apply a monotonicity regularizer with weight of 0.1.
paragraphs.zh: 外观分解是一项高度模糊的任务，这使得定量评估充满挑战。 为了应对这种模糊性，我们为论文中提出的所有多视角方法拟合了一个参数化相机响应函数（CRF）和曝光值。 我们使用 Grossberg 和 Nayar（2004）的方法对响应函数进行参数化，并通过重渲染损失（Liu 等人，2020）对其进行拟合。 具体来说，对于所有可用的视角，我们使用原始光照条件和预测的材料，以 HDR 格式渲染该物体。 然后，我们在曝光和 CRF 拟合之间开始交替优化，总共得到 10 个可训练参数（1 个曝光值和每个颜色通道的 3 个曲线参数）。 我们首先应用曝光，然后应用学习到的 CRF 对图像进行色调映射，并使用 L1 损失与原始图像进行比较。 我们对曝光进行 25 步调整，接着对 CRF 参数进行 200 步调整，并以 0.01 的学习率交替执行 20 个周期。 遵循 IRIS（Lin 等人，2025）的方法，我们应用了一个权重为 0.1 的单调性正则化器。

paragraphs.en: As described in the main text, we are combining our proposed super-resolution model with noise rolling. The super-resolution model is trained on 512 × 512 512\times 512 input and 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 output resolution, giving 4 × \times upscaling. To scale this further to handle 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 inputs, we apply progressive noise rolling. First, we generate the texture in native 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 resolution, then upsample it with nearest neighbor interpolation. We add noise according to timestep 0.2 and denoise with 50 steps using noise rolling. In Table S2 we report the runtime cost and peak VRAM usage for these generations.
paragraphs.zh: 如正文所述，我们将我们提出的超分辨率模型与噪声滚动相结合。 该超分辨率模型以 512 × 512 512\times 512 的输入和 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 的输出分辨率进行训练，实现了 4 × \times 的放大。 为了进一步扩展以处理 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 的输入，我们应用了渐进式噪声滚动。 首先，我们以原生 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 分辨率生成纹理，然后使用最近邻插值进行上采样。 我们根据时间步长 0.2 添加噪声，并通过噪声滚动使用 50 步进行去噪。 在表 S2 中，我们报告了这些生成过程的运行时间和峰值显存使用情况。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method using standard image-quality and perceptual metrics. For reconstruction tasks, including material extraction from multi-view captures, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. For generative tasks, such as text-to-material and single-view material generation, we report distribution-based metrics CLIP-FID and CMMD, following common practice.

paragraphs.en: Our protocol differs from the Stanford-ORB methodology ( Kuang et al., 2023 ) adopted by DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) and LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) . The Stanford-ORB protocol uses a lower resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels and erodes the reference image mask by 5 × 5 5\times 5 pixels, inserting black background in both reference and rendered image in the eroded regions. Furthermore, they use two variants of PSNR, one (PSNR-L) applied to srgb-remapped clipped (to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) linear color values, and another (PSNR-H) applied to linear values which are clipped to [ 0 , 4 ] [0,4] . In both cases, the images are normalized using a mean color normalization approach ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) . The set of evaluation views are also different. As a consistency check, we evaluated the LSRM materials using the Stanford-ORB metrics pipeline and obtained scores comparable to those reported in the original paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的协议与 DTC（Dong et al., 2025）和 LSRM（Li et al., 2026b）所采用的斯坦福-ORB方法（Kuang et al., 2023）有所不同。 斯坦福-ORB协议使用分辨率为 512 × 512 像素的较低分辨率，并将参考图像掩码进行 5 × 5 像素的腐蚀操作，在参考图像和渲染图像的腐蚀区域中插入黑色背景。 此外，他们使用了两种变体的 PSNR：一种（PSNR-L）应用于经过 sRGB 重新映射并裁剪至 [0, 1] 的线性颜色值；另一种（PSNR-H）应用于裁剪至 [0, 4] 的线性值。 在这两种情况下，图像都通过均值颜色归一化方法（Zhang et al., 2021）进行归一化处理。 评估视角的集合也存在差异。 为了验证一致性，我们使用斯坦福-ORB指标流程对 LSRM 材料进行了评估，所得分数与原始论文中报告的分数相当。

sents.en: Our protocol differs from the Stanford-ORB methodology ( Kuang et al., 2023 ) adopted by DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) and LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 我们的协议与 DTC（Dong et al., 2025）和 LSRM（Li et al., 2026b）所采用的斯坦福-ORB方法（Kuang et al., 2023）有所不同。

sents.en: The Stanford-ORB protocol uses a lower resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels and erodes the reference image mask by 5 × 5 5\times 5 pixels, inserting black background in both reference and rendered image in the eroded regions.
sents.zh: 斯坦福-ORB协议使用分辨率为 512 × 512 像素的较低分辨率，并将参考图像掩码进行 5 × 5 像素的腐蚀操作，在参考图像和渲染图像的腐蚀区域中插入黑色背景。

sents.en: Furthermore, they use two variants of PSNR, one (PSNR-L) applied to srgb-remapped clipped (to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) linear color values, and another (PSNR-H) applied to linear values which are clipped to [ 0 , 4 ] [0,4] .
sents.zh: 此外，他们使用了两种变体的 PSNR：一种（PSNR-L）应用于经过 sRGB 重新映射并裁剪至 [0, 1] 的线性颜色值；另一种（PSNR-H）应用于裁剪至 [0, 4] 的线性值。

sents.en: In both cases, the images are normalized using a mean color normalization approach ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，图像都通过均值颜色归一化方法（Zhang et al., 2021）进行归一化处理。

sents.en: The set of evaluation views are also different.
sents.zh: 评估视角的集合也存在差异。

sents.en: As a consistency check, we evaluated the LSRM materials using the Stanford-ORB metrics pipeline and obtained scores comparable to those reported in the original paper.
sents.zh: 为了验证一致性，我们使用斯坦福-ORB指标流程对 LSRM 材料进行了评估，所得分数与原始论文中报告的分数相当。

paragraphs.en: TEXGen ( Yu et al., 2024 ) introduced generative diffuse material creation in texture space, guided by an additional 3D structure to capture object-space locality. Our approach generates full materials using texture space diffusion from finetuned 2D diffusion priors. For a fair comparison, we compute metrics for our method and TEXGen in the single-image to material setting for diffuse-only renderings in Figure 7 and show a few example generated albedo maps in Figure S4 . Note that our method solves a more complex task: predicting full PBR materials from a shaded view, while TEXGen predicts only albedo maps from a demodulated view. Our method produces more coherent materials and we score higher in all metrics computed on the evaluation set of 2048 relit views.
paragraphs.zh: TEXGen（Yu 等人，2024）在纹理空间中引入了生成式漫反射材料创建方法，并通过一个额外的三维结构进行引导，以捕捉物体空间中的局部性。 我们的方法利用经过微调的二维扩散先验，通过纹理空间扩散生成完整的材料。 为了进行公平比较，我们在图 7 中针对仅漫反射渲染的单图像到材料设置，计算了我们的方法与 TEXGen 的各项指标，并在图 S4 中展示了几张生成的反照率图示例。 需要注意的是，我们的方法解决了一个更复杂的任务：从带阴影的视角预测完整的 PBR 材料，而 TEXGen 仅能从去调制后的视角预测反照率图。 我们的方法能生成更具连贯性的材料，并且在由 2048 个重新打光视角组成的评估集上计算的所有指标中均得分更高。

paragraphs.en: Our upscaler network mainly serves as a tool that we use along with noise rolling ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ; Vecchio et al., 2024 ) for higher resolution results, and is designed similarly to previous work. Current generative pipelines typically use ESRGAN ( Wang et al., 2018 ) to either directly upscale material parameter textures ( Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025 ) , or to upscale rendered images and rely on differentiable rendering tricks to propagate the results to the material parameters, one notable example is PBR-SR ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . We report quantitative results in Table S4 , as expected our upscaler performs on par with previous work, with differences mainly being due to training dataset and our method being intended for texture space use. Notably PBR-SR ( Chen et al., 2025a ) performs better on roughness and metallicity parameters, which is due to their expensive multi-view differentiable rendering optimization step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的超分辨率网络主要作为一种工具，与噪声滚动（Bar-Tal 等人，2023；Vecchio 等人，2024）结合使用，以获得更高分辨率的结果，其设计也与先前的研究类似。 当前的生成式流程通常使用 ESRGAN（Wang 等人，2018），要么直接对材质参数纹理进行超分辨率处理（Tencent Hunyuan3D Team，2025），要么对渲染后的图像进行超分辨率处理，并依赖可微分渲染技术将结果传播到材质参数中，其中一个典型的例子是 PBR-SR（Chen 等人，2025a）。 我们在表 S4 中报告了定量结果。正如预期的那样，我们的超分辨率方法与先前的研究表现相当，差异主要源于训练数据集的不同以及我们的方法专为纹理空间使用而设计。 值得注意的是，PBR-SR（Chen 等人，2025a）在粗糙度和金属度参数上的表现更优，这归因于其成本高昂的多视角可微分渲染优化步骤。

sents.zh: 图 S8 展示了来自我们合成数据集的另一个示例场景，其中我们使用四个不同的种子运行了相同的文本到材质生成过程。

sents.en: The Wan 2.1 RoPE results show higher variance, with the model struggling to separate geometric components in texture space.
sents.zh: Wan 2.1 RoPE 的结果显示出更高的方差，模型难以在纹理空间中区分几何组件。

paragraphs.en: In Figure S9 we show examples of materials generated from text conditioning only. Even though our method operates in disjoint texture space, the 3D RoPE encoding provides enough information to generate semantically meaningful materials. Texture space discontinuities also often coincide with material borders (e.g. the “Marshall” text) which can sometimes benefit our model over the image space alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 S9 中，我们展示了仅通过文本条件生成的材料示例。 尽管我们的方法在分离的纹理空间中运行，但 3D RoPE 编码提供了足够的信息来生成具有语义意义的材料。 纹理空间的不连续性通常也与材料边界重合（例如“Marshall”文本），这在某些情况下可能比图像空间的替代方案更有利于我们的模型。
